description: #199: h10_chain_ccpvdz_j's molecule, basis and recorded density, with PySCF's get_jk exchange matrix K (vk_il = sum_jk (ij|kl) D_jk) in place of J. -- the basis and the exchange arrays only, copied by tools/extract_integral_golden.py
